CalibrationSettingController

class CalibrationSettingController(view, service=None)[source]

Bases: QObject

Controller of the calibration settings window.

Parameters:
viewCalibrationSettingView

The settings dialog.

serviceCalibrationSettingService | None, optional

Settings service. Default is None, which creates a new CalibrationSettingService.

Attributes:
viewCalibrationSettingView

The settings dialog.

serviceCalibrationSettingService

Settings service.

calibration_groupQButtonGroup

Exclusive group of the three “default calibration” check boxes.

Notes

The saved settings are loaded first and the check box group is created afterwards, selecting the automatic calibration as default. TODO(doc): this overrides the saved default calibration mode; is it intended?

Messages are translated with self.tr().

Methods

handle_cancel

Reject the dialog without saving.

handle_ok

Save the settings and close the dialog.

list_proportions

Fill the ratio combo box with the supported proportions.
list_proportions()[source]

Fill the ratio combo box with the supported proportions.

handle_ok()[source]

Save the settings and close the dialog.

Notes

On success, an information message is shown and the dialog is accepted; if the settings are not valid, an error message is shown and the dialog stays open.

handle_cancel()[source]

Reject the dialog without saving.
